# PageJsonlWriter

*Block · writers · `linecaster.blocks.writers`*

Writes the page records as JSON Lines, one file per task, or into item shards for a later stage.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Unit | page |
| Role | writer |
| Reads | - |
| Adds | - |
| Replaces | - |
| Comes after | - |
| Comes before | - |
| Used in | - |
| Source | [records.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/src/linecaster/blocks/writers/records.py) |

The contract is that of `PageJsonlWriter(output_folder='out/pages')`; the comes-after and comes-before rows are derived from every block's contract.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_folder` | `DataFolderLike` | required | the folder (local path, fsspec URI or `DataFolder`) the records go to. |
| `output_filename` | `str` | `'${rank}.jsonl.gz'` | the file name, datatrove's template (`${rank}`, `${item_id}`, ...). |
| `item_shards` | `int \| None` | `None` | the number of item shards: every page goes into its item's shard folder (`<shard>/<output_filename>`, `linecaster.blocks.writers.shards`), so a later stage reads whole items; default: no shards. |
| `**kwargs` |  |  | datatrove's `JsonlWriter` arguments (`compression`, `max_file_size`, ...). |

## Behavior

A row per page: `schema` (`linecaster.page/2`), `id`, `text`, `page` (the page record without the
image bytes) and `errors` when a block failed on the page. It reads no part in particular (the whole page
record). The files' flush is reported to the observers. Pages pass through.

    r0["page stream"] --> B
